verdict.rationale: Adyen documents official SDKs for web/iOS/Android/React Native/Flutter and a public OpenAPI spec repo as the 'single source of truth' usable to generate client libraries, which supports SDK-based building; however, the OpenAPI/spec endpoint probes returned 404s and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK quality or completeness for AI-native workflows specifically. missing for 10: independent verification of official SDK repos/quality, working OpenAPI spec endpoint (probe returned 404s), hands-on developer confirmation of SDK-based agentic integration.
